data.title: Absolute frequency measurement of the 171Yb optical lattice clock at KRISS using TAI for over a year
data.authors: Kim, H.; Heo, M.-S.; Park, C. Y.; Yu, D.-H.; Lee, W.-K.
data.notes: arXiv:2108.00108. Metrologia vol. 58, art. 055007 (2021). Absolute frequency of 171Yb 1S0(F=1/2)->3P0(F=1/2) clock transition: 518295836590863.75(14) Hz, fractional uncertainty 2.6e-16. Measurement over 14 months referenced to TAI. Key datum: highest-precision absolute frequency for the 171Yb clock transition available at time of writing. Appears in Abstract and Figure 9/Section 4.

properties.energy_cm1_note: derived from absolute clock transition frequency 518295836590863.75(14) Hz / c; more precise than NIST ASD value (17288.439 cm^-1 for 174Yb)

properties.note: 1S0(F=1/2)->3P0(F=1/2) clock transition; only one hyperfine state for each J=0 level (I=1/2). Measurement via optical lattice clock over 14 months against TAI.
